content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. Research shows that sets taken close to failure (about 0-3 reps in reserve) build similar muscle across a wide range, from roughly 5 to 30 reps. Lighter loads just need more reps and more effort to get there.

💡 For your 100 kg bench goal, though, heavy work matters. Strength is specific, so you need to practice low-rep sets (around 3-6 reps) on the bench. A mix works best: heavy compounds for strength, and moderate-to-high rep accessories for muscle.
